title: Find your next place
lead: When you move out, getproperty can show vacant places where you are moving to — only if you turn it on.
footnote: Your current landlord does not see where you are moving to. You can also change this in

status.title: Relocation help is on
status.privacy: We use only the destination and budget you give us, and your rent record goes to a new landlord only when you send it.
status.onBody: When you give notice on a lease, an offer appears here and in LINE. Tell us where you are moving to and see places there.
status.stoppedBody: Open offers are closed and the destinations you gave are erased. Nothing else changes.

consent.title: Turn on relocation help
consent.changedTitle: The text has changed — please read it again
consent.lead: Optional. Saying no changes nothing about your lease or any other service.
consent.heading: Consent text from getproperty
consent.english: This text is available in Thai and English only, so it is shown in English.
consent.agree: I agree to the text above (version {version})
consent.agreeHint: You can stop at any time, in one tap.
consent.required: Tick the box to turn relocation help on.

unavailable.title: Not available at the moment
unavailable.body: Relocation help is not offered right now. Please try again later.

offers.title: My moves
offers.destination: {count, plural, =0 {No places there yet} one {# place there} other {# places there}}
offers.destinationBudget: {count, plural, =0 {No places there yet} one {# place there} other {# places there}} · up to {budget}
offers.whereTo: Tell us where you are moving to
offers.emptyOnBody: An offer appears here when you or your landlord give notice on a lease.
offers.emptyOffBody: Turn on relocation help to get offers after a move-out notice.
offers.preparingBody: Your lease has a move-out notice. Your offer appears here in a moment — open this page again shortly.

offer.title: Where are you moving to?
offer.missingBody: It may have closed. Your other moves are on the relocation page.
offer.offBody: Turn it on again to see places where you are moving to.

dismissed.title: You closed this offer
dismissed.body: Its destination was erased. No more places are shown for this move.

withdrawn.title: Relocation help was stopped
withdrawn.body: This offer closed and its destination was erased.

closed.title: This move has ended
closed.body: Offers close after the lease ends. Its destination was erased.

offer.footnote: Places come from public listings on getproperty. Your current landlord does not see this page.

destination.title: Destination and budget
destination.lead: Pick an area or station, or type a province for places outside the list.
destination.currentBudget: Looking in {place}, up to {budget} a month
destination.privacy: Used only to show you places. Erased when this offer closes or you stop.
destination.areasUnavailable: The list of areas could not be loaded. Type a province instead.

area.label: Area or station
area.hint: For example Ari, Chatuchak, On Nut
area.noMatch: Nothing matches "{query}". Try another name, or choose by province.

place.label: Province and district
place.provinceHint: For example เชียงใหม่ (in Thai, as on listings)
place.districtHint: For example เมืองเชียงใหม่

budget.label: Highest rent a month (baht, optional)
budget.hint: Only places up to this rent are shown
budget.invalid: Type an amount in baht, for example 12000

destination.saved: Saved. The places below are updated.

listings.title: {count, plural, =0 {Places there} one {# place there} other {# places there}}
listings.lead: Ask an owner directly from here.
listings.leadRecord: Ask an owner directly from here — and send your rent record with it if you want.
listings.enquired: {count, plural, one {You asked about # place from this offer} other {You asked about # places from this offer}}
listings.emptyBody: Try a nearby area or a higher budget. New listings appear here as they are published.

enquire.title: Ask the owner
enquire.messagePlaceholder: For example: I am moving at the start of next month. Is the room still free?

share.label: Send my rent record with this message
share.hint: The owner sees your confirmed months only: on time {onTime}, late {late}, unpaid {outstanding}. Not a score. You can stop sharing later.
share.none: Your rent record has no confirmed month yet, so it cannot be sent.

consent.label: I agree that the owner of this listing uses my name, messages and LINE to answer me and arrange a viewing
consent.hint: Used only for renting this place, under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act.
consent.required: Please give your consent before sending

done.title: Sent to the owner
done.created: The owner answers in LINE. Your conversation is in My enquiries.
done.followUp: Added to your conversation with this owner.
done.recordShared: Your rent record went with it. You can stop sharing in your rent record.
done.recordNotYet: Your rent record was not sent: it has no confirmed month yet.
done.recordKept: Your rent record was not sent.

dismiss.cta: No more places for this move
dismiss.title: Close this offer?
dismiss.body: We stop showing places for this move and erase its destination. Relocation help stays on for future moves.

prompt.title: Moving out? Find your next place
prompt.body: getproperty can show vacant places where you are moving to, and send your rent record to a new landlord when you ask. Your landlord does not see it.

how.title: How it works
how.where: When you or your landlord give notice, tell us where you are moving to and your budget. We show vacant places there from public listings.
how.private: Your current landlord does not see where you are moving to, and the destination is erased when the move ends or you stop.
how.record: Ask an owner from the list in one step — your rent record goes with it only if you tick it.
